meta.source: US Census Bureau, ACS 2020-2024 5-Year Estimates, table B19049 (median household income by age of householder)
meta.note: B19049 only publishes four age brackets (Under 25 / 25-44 / 45-64 / 65+) — finer than that isn't available through the Census API's structured tables, so the 25-34/35-44 pair and the 45-54/55-64 pair below each share one underlying ACS figure. lib/usIncomeCalc.ts rescales by median (not mean) here, since median is the real reported statistic at this age granularity — no age-band mean is published by the Census API.
